name: Rainfall
description: Satellite-based monthly precipitation estimates from the Global Precipitation Measurement mission.
why_it_matters: Changes in rainfall can affect water availability, agriculture, flood risk and drought. In Pakistan, monsoon shifts can mean the difference between a productive growing season and a water crisis.
disclaimer: A trend does not by itself prove its cause or guarantee it will continue.
citation: Huffman, G.J., et al. (2023). GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07, Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC).

name: Soil Moisture
dataset: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 Monthly
description: Model-estimated soil moisture from the Global Land Data Assimilation System.
why_it_matters: Less soil moisture can stress crops and vegetation; more can affect farming conditions and flood risk. In the Indus Basin, soil moisture is a critical indicator of agricultural water availability.
disclaimer: A trend does not by itself prove its cause or guarantee it will continue. GLDAS is a model product, not a direct satellite observation.
citation: Rodell, M., et al. (2004). The Global Land Data Assimilation System, Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc., 85(3), 381-394.

name: Aerosol Optical Depth
dataset: MODIS/Terra Aerosol 5-Min L2 Swath (MOD04_L2) — Monthly Aggregated
description: Satellite-measured aerosol optical depth indicating atmospheric haze and pollution levels.
mission_or_instrument: MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) on Terra
why_it_matters: Haze changes can affect air quality, visibility and sunlight reaching the surface. In the Lahore airshed, seasonal smog events have been intensifying, impacting millions of people.
disclaimer: A trend does not by itself prove its cause or guarantee it will continue.
citation: Levy, R., et al. (2015). MODIS Atmosphere L2 Aerosol Product. NASA MODIS Adaptive Processing System, Goddard Space Flight Center.

name: Temperature
description: Reanalysis-based monthly 2-meter air temperature from MERRA-2.
mission_or_instrument: MERRA-2 (Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2)
why_it_matters: Long-term temperature changes can affect water demand, ecosystems, agriculture and heat exposure. Pakistan is one of the most climate-vulnerable countries.
disclaimer: A trend does not by itself prove its cause or guarantee it will continue. MERRA-2 is a reanalysis product blending observations and model output.
citation: Gelaro, R., et al. (2017). The Modern-Era Retrospective Analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 (MERRA-2). J. Climate, 30(14), 5419-5454.

name: Vegetation Greenness (NDVI)
dataset: MOD13C2 MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global
description: Satellite-derived normalized difference vegetation index indicating vegetation health and greenness.
why_it_matters: Vegetation greenness may reflect growing-season conditions, drought stress, land use or vegetation health.
disclaimer: A trend does not by itself prove its cause or guarantee it will continue.
citation: Didan, K. (2021). MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG V061. NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC.
